line:insanity_mystic_greeting: insanity_mystic: I sense madness in you, seeker.
line:insanity_mystic_opt_ask: What do you want from me?
line:insanity_mystic_compass_already: insanity_mystic: Nothing for now. The compass is already in your hands.
line:insanity_mystic_compass_intro: insanity_mystic: I keep a thing here. It waits for a hand worthy of it.
line:insanity_mystic_compass_offer: insanity_mystic: If you bring me 5 strange fish, I will give you something interesting. But mind - I do not tolerate duplicates.
line:insanity_mystic_compass_done: insanity_mystic: You did well, seeker. For that, take the compass. It points where the map stays silent.
line:insanity_mystic_compass_fail: insanity_mystic: Five different strange fish. You have not brought them.
